music_winds_aero_attacks_missed_head: Right notes, but {missed}. Tongue with the click, not after it.
music_winds_aero_back_forth_bpm: back and forth in eighths at {bpm} BPM
music_winds_aero_band_guide: steady air sits in this band (a guide, not scored)
music_winds_aero_blocked_range: That scale doesn't fit the Aerophone's charted range in this key.
music_winds_aero_blurb_long: Each scale note held four beats at one breath level, in the band from bottom to top.
music_winds_aero_blurb_register: Across the break and over the octave keys, back and forth, with no glitch notes in between.
music_winds_aero_blurb_scales: Scales and arpeggios in any key, in time, in patterns and over two octaves.
music_winds_aero_blurb_swing: Swung eighths after Niehaus: long-short, each off-beat tongued and slurred into the beat.
music_winds_aero_blurb_tonguing: Slurred and tongued on purpose: tongued stops the air, slurred keeps it going.
music_winds_aero_blurb_trills: Two fingerings back and forth as fast and even as you can.
music_winds_aero_blurb_vibrato: Vibrato with the bite, pulsed in time, a set number of pulses a click.
music_winds_aero_breath_at_unmeasured: Breath at {level} (no breath arrived from the breath sensor)
music_winds_aero_breath_label_level: Breath over time, the shaded band is {level}
music_winds_aero_clean_long: 9 in 10 notes right and the breath in the band 80% of the time
music_winds_aero_clean_register: a score of 90% or more, with at most one glitch across the break
music_winds_aero_clean_swing: a score of 80% or more, with 9 in 10 notes right, a clear swing and 8 in 10 doo-DAHs as marked
music_winds_aero_clean_tonguing: a score of 90% or more, 8 in 10 joins as marked and 3 in 4 attacks on the click
music_winds_aero_clean_trills: 4 or more notes a second, 70% even, no stray notes
music_winds_aero_cue_check: Check: play the line in time
music_winds_aero_doodah_unmeasured: Doo-DAH (no breath arrived from the breath sensor)
music_winds_aero_glitches_fix: {count}: move the fingers and the thumb together
music_winds_aero_go_timed: Play in time with the click.
music_winds_aero_go_trill: Trill {pair}: the clock starts on your first note.
music_winds_aero_go_vibrato: Hold {note} and pulse the bite {pulses} times a click.
music_winds_aero_grade_speeds_help: Grade speeds (NZMEB saxophone): one tap sets the tempo and the notes a click.
music_winds_aero_head_notes: {right} of {total} notes right. Slow down until every fingering lands.
music_winds_aero_long_off: Every note right, but the breath sat at {level} for only {pct} of the scale. Aim for the shaded band.
music_winds_aero_make_long: half the line, half the breath band
music_winds_aero_make_tonguing: 80% notes and tonguing, 20% on the click
music_winds_aero_marks_help: T: tongue it (stop the air). ⌒: slur into it from the note before.
music_winds_aero_marks_swing: Doo on the off-beat, DAH into the beat.
music_winds_aero_no_bite: No bite arrived: set the bite to send pitch bend (E-Wind bite mode gives vibrato), then try again.
music_winds_aero_no_note: No note arrived. The line under the stage says whether the Aerophone is connected.
music_winds_aero_pitch_still: The pitch held still: pulse the bite in time with the click.
music_winds_aero_register_off: Right notes, but the crossing left glitches between them.
music_winds_aero_slips: {right} of {total} right. {count} came out an octave off: {slip}.
music_winds_aero_spacing: Every note right, but the spacing wandered {ms} ms. Keep it even.
music_winds_aero_swing_head_notes: {right} of {total} notes right. Slow down until every fingering lands.
music_winds_aero_swing_help: Swung eighths at the top bar's tempo: tongue each off-beat (doo) and slur into the beat (DAH). Written straight, played long-short.
music_winds_aero_swing_row: Swing (off-beat late in the beat, about 2 to 1)
music_winds_aero_swing_written: Written straight, as swing charts are: play each pair long-short.
music_winds_aero_swung_tongue: Swung, but tongue each off-beat and slur into the beat: doo-DAH.
music_winds_aero_tonguing_off: Right notes, but the tonguing wasn't as marked. Tongue (stop the air) only where it says T.
music_winds_aero_tonguing_unmeasured: Tonguing (no breath arrived from the breath sensor)
music_winds_aero_too_jerky: Too jerky ({ratio} to 1): the off-beat sits a triplet late, not a sixteenth.
music_winds_aero_too_jerky_uneven: Too jerky (uneven): the off-beat sits a triplet late, not a sixteenth.
music_winds_aero_too_straight: Too straight ({ratio} to 1): lean on the beat and play the off-beat later.
music_winds_aero_trill_help: Trill {pair}: move only the finger that changes.
music_winds_aero_trill_help_detail: Trill {pair} ({detail}): move only the finger that changes.
music_winds_aero_trill_seconds: {n} seconds, as fast and even as you can
music_winds_aero_trill_slow: {rate} a second: aim for 4 or more, even.
music_winds_aero_trill_strays: {count} stray notes: move only the finger that changes.
music_winds_aero_trill_uneven: Uneven ({pct}): slower and steady first, then faster.
music_winds_aero_vibrato_help: Hold {note} steadily and pulse the bite {pulses} times a click: the click plays at {bpm} BPM. The bite reaches Woodshed as pitch bend.
music_winds_attack_caption: Attacks: {style}, each note sounds {pct}% of its beat
music_winds_attack_caption_offsets: Attacks: {style}, each note sounds {pct}% of its beat. Numbers: ms from the click, minus is early
music_winds_breath_blow: Blow to test the breath sensor
music_winds_breath_none: No breath data: the chart and computer keys can't send breath. Play the Aerophone to see it.
music_winds_cal_assistance: A setup check: it doesn't change your skill scores.
music_winds_cal_bite_no: none seen. Set the bite to send pitch bend for vibrato
music_winds_cal_bite_yes: arrives, so vibrato can be read
music_winds_cal_blurb: Check the AE-20 setup: the note it sends, the breath, and soft to loud without clipping.
music_winds_cal_breath_label: Breath, last 64 samples. The dashed line is f
music_winds_cal_head_ceiling: Your loudest note reached {ceiling}, under f ({target}). Turn the breath sensitivity up a step.
music_winds_cal_head_clipped: The loud note pinned at the top for {pct} of it. Turn the AE-20's breath sensitivity down a step.
music_winds_cal_head_floor: Your softest note read {floor}: aim for p or under ({target}). Lower the AE-20's breath sensitivity, or blow softer.
music_winds_cal_head_key_fits: Written G4 came in as concert {received}: the AE-20 reads as {fits}, Woodshed as {key}. Match one to the other.
music_winds_cal_head_key_unknown: Written G4 came in as concert {received}, which no reading key explains. Check the AE-20's transpose and octave settings.
music_winds_cal_head_no_breath: The key matches, but no breath arrived (CC 2). Check the AE-20's breath output.
music_winds_cal_head_ok: Setup is right: the key matches and the breath reaches from p to f without clipping.
music_winds_cal_key_say: Finger a written G4 and play it at any level.
music_winds_cal_loud_say: Now as loud as you can, any note: hold it 3 seconds.
music_winds_cal_setup_help: On the AE-20, choose Sax mode and the scene you play. Woodshed reads in {key}. Change it with Reads in on the top bar, or in Settings. With the AE-20's transpose at C, read in C. At Eb (alto) or Bb (tenor), read in that key.
music_winds_cal_soft_say: Now your softest steady note, any note: hold it 3 seconds.
music_winds_cal_sum_steps: a written G4, then softest and loudest
music_winds_chop_blocked_import: Import your loop first, or pick one of Woodshed's.
music_winds_chop_blurb: A loop cut into 16 slices, one a pad. Play them back in order, in a new order, or chop your own.
music_winds_chop_demo_loop: Demo: the loop, slice by slice. Not scored.
music_winds_chop_demo_written: Demo: the slices as written. Not scored.
music_winds_chop_file_hint: Trimmed to the loop, one or more whole bars. Kept until you leave the page.
music_winds_chop_file_loaded: {name}: {seconds} s. Set how many bars it is. The tempo follows.
music_winds_chop_file_unreadable: That file couldn't be read as audio. Try a WAV or MP3.
music_winds_chop_free_help: Bars 1 to {bars}: play any slices, in any rhythm, to the click. Bars {from} to {to}: play the same again. Scored on playing it again and on time. Hear it back after.
music_winds_chop_grid_avg: {ms} ms from the sixteenth grid on average
music_winds_chop_head_correct: Every slice in its place, {ms} ms off on average.
music_winds_chop_head_free_ok: A chop of {count} hits, played again {pct} the same, in time.
music_winds_chop_head_grid_off: {ms} ms from the grid on average: aim under 25 ms.
music_winds_chop_head_no_hits: No hits arrived. Check the line under the stage for why.
music_winds_chop_head_repeat_low: The second take matched {pct} of the first: keep the pattern simple enough to play twice.
music_winds_chop_head_too_few: Only {count} hits in the first four bars: make a pattern of at least {min}.
music_winds_chop_head_wrong_pad: {missed} slices missed and {extra} extra: some went to the wrong pad. The play order shows which.
music_winds_chop_own_loop_detail: A WAV or MP3 you import
music_winds_chop_pads_label: MPC pads, bank A, a slice on each. Computer keys Z X C V play the bottom row.
music_winds_chop_repeat_text: {pct} of the first take found again in the second
music_winds_chop_status_free: Bars 1 to {bars}: play your own chop. Then play it again.
music_winds_chop_status_order: Slice 1 to 16, one after the other: the loop should come back.
music_winds_chop_step_beat: A beat a step. A dot lets the slice before ring.
music_winds_chop_step_eighth: An eighth a step. A dot lets the slice before ring.
music_winds_chop_step_in_order: In order, a slice each step.
music_winds_chop_step_sixteenth: A sixteenth a step. A dot lets the slice before ring.
music_winds_midi_all_ignored_aerophone: Every Aerophone port is ignored in Connect, so none of its notes reach the drill.
music_winds_midi_all_ignored_device: Every device port is ignored in Connect, so none of its notes reach the drill.
music_winds_midi_all_ignored_mpc: Every MPC port is ignored in Connect, so none of its notes reach the drill.
music_winds_midi_dropped_channel: A note from {name} was dropped: it came on channel {channel}, and Connect pins the device to channel {pinned}.
music_winds_midi_dropped_hidden: A note from {name} was dropped: that device is hidden in Connect.
music_winds_midi_hearing_pad_default: Hearing {name}. Last hit: pad {pad}, using the default pad order.
music_winds_midi_hearing_pad_unsaved: Hearing {name}. Last hit: pad {pad} (not in your saved pad map).
music_winds_midi_linked: Linked and listening on {ports}. Hit a pad.
music_winds_midi_no_port_aerophone: No Aerophone port is connected. On-screen input works meanwhile.
music_winds_midi_no_port_device: No device port is connected. On-screen input works meanwhile.
music_winds_midi_no_port_mpc: No MPC port is connected. On-screen input works meanwhile.
music_winds_midi_no_webmidi: This browser has no Web MIDI. Use Chrome or Edge, or play on screen.
music_winds_midi_off: MIDI is off, so no hardware notes reach this drill.
music_winds_midi_outside_bank: {name} sent a pad outside bank A, so no pad lights. Save the pad map for your drum program in Connect.

match.countPlural=one: {ports} is connected, but no pad hit has arrived yet. If the pads stay silent here, link it in Connect.
match.countPlural=other: {ports} are connected, but no pad hit has arrived yet. If the pads stay silent here, link it in Connect.

match.countPlural=one: {ports} is connected, but no pad hit has arrived yet. If the pads stay silent here, its output isn't connected, so check the cable, then Connect.
match.countPlural=other: {ports} are connected, but no pad hit has arrived yet. If the pads stay silent here, its output isn't connected, so check the cable, then Connect.

match.countPlural=one: {ports} is connected, but no pad hit has arrived yet. If the pads stay silent here, allow SysEx, then link it in Connect.
match.countPlural=other: {ports} are connected, but no pad hit has arrived yet. If the pads stay silent here, allow SysEx, then link it in Connect.

music_winds_nothing_to_measure: Nothing to measure, so nothing is saved.
music_winds_skills_aftertouch_maybe: If your pads send aftertouch, pressure sets the level. Otherwise each repeat keeps the hit's velocity.
music_winds_skills_aftertouch_text: the pads send it: pressure set the repeats' level
music_winds_skills_aftertouch_yes: Your pads send aftertouch, so pressure sets the level.
music_winds_skills_all_sections: Every section passed in one take.
music_winds_skills_all_sections_level: Every section passed in one take, each at its level.
music_winds_skills_blocked_missing: That piece isn't saved here: pick another, or write a new one.
music_winds_skills_blocked_range: Set your soft-to-loud range first: press Calibrate.
music_winds_skills_blurb_dynamics: Velocity on purpose: levels, a crescendo, even hits, against your own soft-to-loud range.
music_winds_skills_blurb_echo: Hear a bar, play it back in the next: four rounds, scored on the answers.
music_winds_skills_blurb_fills: Three bars of groove, a fill, and the crash and kick back on the one, without rushing.
music_winds_skills_blurb_improvise: Improvise over the band, scored on time and on keeping every bar going. Hear it back as played, or nudged to the grid.
music_winds_skills_blurb_orchestrate: A rudiment spread across the kit: the sticking becomes a groove.
music_winds_skills_blurb_ostinato: One hand keeps the ostinato while the other reads a line. The ostinato is scored against playing it alone.
music_winds_skills_blurb_phrases: Short drum phrases drummers know by name: clave cells, a tag ending, a fill and landing, a build. Hear one, then play it on the pads.
music_winds_skills_blurb_repeat: Note Repeat as the MPC has it: hold a pad and it plays again on the rate's grid. Pressure sets the level when the pads send aftertouch.
music_winds_skills_blurb_song: A whole piece in one take: intro, grooves, a build or a chorus, an ending, each section scored with its own level.
music_winds_skills_build_climb: Make it climb: press harder each bar, or lean into the pad if it sends aftertouch.
music_winds_skills_build_hold: {sections}: hold the pad for the whole bar, let go for the drop.
music_winds_skills_build_needs_velocity: The build needs velocity: play it on the MPC (Full Level off).
music_winds_skills_build_ok: The build rose all the way and landed on the drop.
music_winds_skills_cal_needs_mpc: Calibration needs the MPC: on-screen pads carry no velocity.
music_winds_skills_cal_prompt: Play your four softest hits on any pad, then your four loudest.
music_winds_skills_cal_too_close: Those were too close together. Try the softest you can, then the hardest.
music_winds_skills_clave_held: The clave held ({together} under the line, {alone} alone).
music_winds_skills_clave_slipped: The clave slipped under the line: {together} against {alone} alone. Slow down until it stays put.
music_winds_skills_cut_error: The chop's loop couldn't be cut: {error}
music_winds_skills_cutting: Cutting the chop's loop into slices…
music_winds_skills_demo_calls: Demo: the four calls. In a run, a bar for your answer follows each.
music_winds_skills_dyn_crescendo_head: Grow more steadily, from your softest to your loudest.
music_winds_skills_dyn_even_head: The level wandered by {pct} of your range.
music_winds_skills_dyn_ladder_head: {pct} of hits in their level. The bars show which drifted.
music_winds_skills_dyn_need_velocity: Dynamics need velocity: play on the MPC (with Full Level off), not the screen.
music_winds_skills_dyn_ok: Controlled: every hit where you meant it.
music_winds_skills_dyn_unmeasured: Dynamics: velocity not measured, so the bands weren't scored
music_winds_skills_echo_help: Each call is a bar on the kit. Play it back in the bar after. The grid shows after the run.
music_winds_skills_fill_every_nth: A fill every {n}th bar, landing on the next one.
music_winds_skills_fill_head_missed: {missed} of {total} notes missed. Slow down until the groove holds, then add the fill.
music_winds_skills_fill_head_no_land: The fill never landed: crash and kick together on the one after it.
music_winds_skills_fill_head_off: Off the one by {ms}: aim the crash at the click.
music_winds_skills_fill_head_rushed: The fill rushed ({ms}): keep its notes the same size as the groove's.
music_winds_skills_go_crescendo: Start as soft as you can and grow to your loudest.
music_winds_skills_go_echo: Listen to the bar, then play it back in the next.
music_winds_skills_go_even: Every hit the same: a steady middle level.
music_winds_skills_go_improvise_band: Improvise: any pads, any rhythm. Listen to the band and lock in.
music_winds_skills_go_improvise_loop: Improvise: any pads, any rhythm, over the loop. Lock in with its kick.
music_winds_skills_go_ladder: Four soft, four a little louder, four louder, four loudest.
music_winds_skills_go_repeat: Hold the pad to repeat it. Let go to stop. The rate follows the chart.
music_winds_skills_grid_avg: {ms} ms from the grid on average
music_winds_skills_hats_held: The hats held ({together} under the line, {alone} alone).
music_winds_skills_hats_slipped: The hats slipped under the line: {together} against {alone} alone. Slow down until it stays put.
music_winds_skills_hear_back_help: Hear it back as you played it, or moved half way onto the beat.
music_winds_skills_hear_nudged: Hear it nudged to the grid
music_winds_skills_impro_drift: The tempo drifted {value} BPM: lock in with the band's kick.
music_winds_skills_impro_fills: {landed} of {expected} fills landed on the one.
music_winds_skills_impro_ok: In time and never stopped: {hits} hits on {pads} pads.
music_winds_skills_impro_quiet: {count} bars went quiet: keep the groove going between ideas.
music_winds_skills_levels_aria: Each hit's level in your range
music_winds_skills_levels_aria_after: Each hit's level in your range, after the run
music_winds_skills_levels_default: Levels are read against your range from Dynamics (not set yet, so a default).
music_winds_skills_levels_range: Levels are read against your range from Dynamics.
music_winds_skills_own_song_help: The chop plays the slices on A01 to A16. Under a solo Woodshed loops a groove and you play over it.
music_winds_skills_pads_label: MPC pads, bank A. Computer keys Z X C V play the bottom row.
music_winds_skills_paradiddle_help: Two bars of sixteenths, the accents on each group's first stroke.
music_winds_skills_play_over_vamp: Play any pads over {bars} bars of a funk vamp.
music_winds_skills_range_first: Set your range first: press Calibrate, then Start.
music_winds_skills_rate_follows: Woodshed sets the rate as the chart changes.
music_winds_skills_read_kick: Two bars of hats alone, then four bars to read with the kick. Four new bars every run. They show from the count-in.
music_winds_skills_read_snare: Two bars of hats alone, then four bars to read with the snare. Four new bars every run. They show from the count-in.
music_winds_skills_rolls_ok: Every roll on its rate, started and stopped in time.
music_winds_skills_rolls_tighten: {count} of 4 roll bars to tighten: press as the roll starts, let go as it ends.
music_winds_skills_scored_on: Scored on timing and on keeping every bar going.
music_winds_skills_shaded: Shaded: where each hit should land. Bars: where yours did.
music_winds_skills_sum_after_rock: after three bars of rock, landing on the one
music_winds_skills_sum_after_shuffle: after three bars of shuffle, landing on the one
music_winds_skills_sum_kick_reads: the kick reads four new bars
music_winds_skills_sum_one_take_set: {bars} bars in one take, the set
music_winds_skills_sum_snare_reads: the snare reads four new bars
music_winds_song_help: Saved as you change it. A chop plays the loop's slices on A01 to A16. A solo is yours over the loop, scored on time and on keeping every bar going.
music_winds_song_set_missing: For the set (the path's last step) it still needs {missing}.
music_winds_song_set_ok: In the set's shape: an intro, grooves from three levels, a chop, a solo, an end, 3 to 5 minutes.
music_winds_status_silent_run_notes: Connected, but no notes arrived during the run.
music_winds_status_silent_run_pads: Connected, but no pad hits arrived during the run.
music_winds_status_sound_title: Off when the MPC makes its own sound
